en: I'm Peter, a carpenter and proud of it.
Mind you, I do more repairs than new builds.
Working hard every day for my family, see.
See you around, then, classy neighbor.
Ha, we meet again. How're you doing?
Hey, mornin'.
What's this? You look awfully sluggish.
Not a morning person? Folks get up, work, and sleep at night.
That's the basics. Go on, eat up and get to it.
How're you doing today?
Me, I always wake up fresh as a daisy.
I'll let you in on the secret sometime.
It's a long day ahead. Go on, give it your all!
Hey, nice night.
Just finished a job?
Something like that.
Are you on your way home from work too?
Just call me Peter.
It's the only name I've got, after all.
I see.
note: Shared: Peter's scene (player), Claude (3 msgs, opening his line), Clotilde (player), villager 86 (player). 'I see.' reads in all.

en: Well, time I headed home.
The wife and kids are waiting.
You take care too. See ya.
Hey now, hurry home before it gets dark.
, it's you. Hey.
note: After the name: '{NAME}, it's you. Hey.' (as #101 ', it's you.')

en: You like roaming around at night, do you?
Quite the rascal, for all your looks. Ha ha ha!
It's not safe these days, so watch yourself.
See you around.
Oh, ran into you again today. Doing well?
You're an odd one. You seem livelier at night.
Seems you turn up all over the place,
but there are odd types about, so be careful.
Whoa there! Hey now, that's no good.
It's dangerous to stand there.
We're doing repairs here, so mind yourself.
Ah. My apologies.
Is this café under construction?
Yep. I'm a carpenter, but I do repairs too.
Truth is, that's most of my work lately.
If your house falls apart, give me a call.
I'll come running and fix it right up.
Peter the carpenter. Don't forget it.
How reassuring. Then I shall do so.
The house I live in now is quite old.
Sure, enjoy your tea, but on your way out,
mind you don't go bumping your head.
Oh, it's you. Hiya, how're you doing?
Ah, my apologies.
Yep. I get more repair jobs these days.
Not that I'm complaining.
What, has your house fallen apart already?
Or are you after another cup of coffee?
Hey, we meet again.
You sure like cafés. Didn't expect that.
Hard at work every day, I see.
Well, hard or not, it's my job.
If I don't do it, nothing gets done.
If you pass by, give me a shout.
Dunno what line of work you're in,
but get to it once your break's over.
, back again?
Hey now, we sure run into each other a lot.
Well, no wonder. We go to the same places.
The repairs here are almost done.
Then I'll tell you my next job, so next time
come by there. You'll find me. Ha ha ha.
Right, that's about done.
Took a while, but it's fine work, I'd say.
Won't need repairs for a good while now.
Truth is, it's heavy work. It ain't easy.
But I love carpentry.
And working for my family isn't half bad.
Hm? Haven't seen you before. Who're you?
Your fence outside seems to have fallen over.
What!? ...Well, so it has
Ha, how embarrassing. I'm a carpenter, see.
A carpenter with a broken house? Not funny.
Thanks for telling me.
I'm Peter the carpenter. Pleased to meet ya.
